mapper.sql: id, question_content, understanding_level, ai_answer, answered_at, manual_remark, remark_updated_at, self_test_answer, self_test_score, self_test_comment, self_test_suggestion, self_test_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM manual_question ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM manual_question ORDER BY CASE understanding_level WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, updated_at DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT FROM manual_question WHERE (#{keyword} IS NULL OR #{keyword} = '' OR question_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND (#{understandingLevel} IS NULL OR #{understandingLevel} = '' OR understanding_level = #{understandingLevel}) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manual_question WHERE (#{keyword} IS NULL OR #{keyword} = '' OR question_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND (#{understandingLevel} IS NULL OR #{understandingLevel} = '' OR understanding_level = #{understandingLevel})
mapper.update: UPDATE manual_question SET ai_answer = #{aiAnswer}, answered_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE manual_question SET manual_remark = #{manualRemark}, remark_updated_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE manual_question SET self_test_answer = #{userAnswer}, self_test_score = #{score}, self_test_comment = #{comment}, self_test_suggestion = #{suggestion}, self_test_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE manual_question SET understanding_level = #{understandingLevel}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE manual_question SET question_content = #{questionContent}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
